title: Request Workflow
prompt:
Execute the following fictional request workflow for Q1-Q8. Return every step ID actually executed, in order, and the final disposition. A terminal step stops the case immediately.

A1 VALIDATE: if well_formed=false -> A2, else A3.
A2 REJECT_INVALID -> REJECT_INVALID, stop.
A3 VERIFY_IDENTITY: if identity_verified=false -> A4, else A5.
A4 REJECT_IDENTITY -> REJECT_IDENTITY, stop.
A5 CHECK_ELIGIBILITY: if eligible=false -> A6, else A7.
A6 DENY_INELIGIBLE -> DENY_INELIGIBLE, stop.
A7 CHECK_RESTRICTION: restricted+urgent -> A8; restricted+not urgent -> A9; otherwise A10.
A8 ESCALATE_RESTRICTED -> ESCALATE_RESTRICTED, stop.
A9 DENY_RESTRICTED -> DENY_RESTRICTED, stop.
A10 CHECK_EVIDENCE: if evidence_complete=false -> A11, else A12.
A11 REQUEST_EVIDENCE -> PENDING_EVIDENCE, stop.
A12 CHECK_RISK: risk=high -> A13, else A14.
A13 ESCALATE_MANUAL_REVIEW -> ESCALATE_MANUAL_REVIEW, stop.
A14 APPROVE -> APPROVE, stop.

Cases (well_formed, identity_verified, eligible, restricted, urgent, evidence_complete, risk):
Q1 false,true,true,false,false,true,low
Q2 true,false,true,true,true,true,high
Q3 true,true,false,false,false,false,high
Q4 true,true,true,true,true,false,high
Q5 true,true,true,true,false,true,high
Q6 true,true,true,false,false,false,high
Q7 true,true,true,false,false,true,high
Q8 true,true,true,false,false,true,low

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"cases":[{"id":"Q1","trace":["A1","A2"],"disposition":"REJECT_INVALID"}, ...]}}
Include exactly Q1-Q8 once each.
